strategy_roster.name: Timer EA
strategy_roster.notes: Reference strategy is not expressible as a deterministic single-security OHLCV entry signal in the TASI DSL; a never-true guard is used rather than fabricating a signal. Unsupported schedule, portfolio, order-management, external-data, or multi-order mechanics are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Morning Evening Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic is approximated from the close position within the 14-bar high/low range because the DSL has no dedicated stochastic function.

strategy_roster.name: Natuseko Protrader 4H
strategy_roster.notes: MACD-based reference translated to the local MACD 12/26/9-style DSL using documented periods where available; unsupported platform-specific filters/order handling are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Post-Holiday Weakness
strategy_roster.notes: Moving-average reference translated with inferred/default periods 10/30; unsupported shifts, recursive state, or execution rules are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Smart AC Trader
